visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide view from inside the museum looking through floor-to-ceiling glass doors onto a wooden deck. The deck overlooks a tranquil body of water with mountains in the background under a clear sky. A green rug sits in the foreground on a polished floor. (2) Exterior shot of the museum building, 'SIMOSE ART MUSEUM,' showing a modern glass facade reflecting the sky and surrounding trees. (3) Interior view of the museum lobby featuring a stunning architectural ceiling made of light wood beams radiating like a tree from a central pillar. A white circular reception counter is visible. (4) An outdoor scene showcases several brightly colored, translucent cube-shaped exhibition rooms floating on a calm body of water. (5) A close-up reflection of a pink and yellow cube in the glass-like water surface. (6) A woman is seen from the back in a gallery space, observing a large, complex, and colorful artwork shaped like a painter's palette on a white wall. (7) An outdoor garden path made of wooden planks winds through flowers and trees, with the museum's glass building reflecting the greenery. (8) A large, intricate metal sculpture of a knight on a horse stands outdoors against a background of mountains. (9) A view down a long, brightly lit corridor with glass walls on both sides, casting rhythmic shadows on a white reflective floor. (10) A woman walks past a massive, curved mural filled with vibrant floral patterns in a spacious white gallery.

(4) [Subtitle]: 邊看展還能 邊欣賞瀨戶內海. (5) [Subtitle]: 館內也有咖啡廳 可以坐著放空超舒服. (6) [Subtitle]: 漂浮在水上的可動式展間 真的很特別. (7) [Subtitle]: 色彩鮮明 拍照怎麼拍都好看. (8) [Subtitle]: 裡面藝術品也很有看點!. (9) [Subtitle]: 整座美術館與自然融合在一起. visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The Simose Art Museum in Japan, featuring modern glass and wood architecture, outdoor floating exhibition cubes, a seaside landscape, and curated garden paths.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio consists of a clean, studio-recorded acoustic cover of the song 'Close to You'. A female singer's voice is prominent, characterized by a soft, melodic, and warm tone singing in English. The accompaniment is primarily a gentle acoustic guitar with subtle piano highlights. There are no spoken words, ambient environmental noises, or post-production sound effects throughout the entire track, providing a peaceful and serene auditory backdrop that matches the visual beauty.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Overview -> Exterior Highlight -> Lobby Reveal -> Landscape View -> Feature Cubes -> Gallery Walkthrough -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-aesthetic travel guide to the Simose Art Museum in Hiroshima, Japan. It aims to inspire viewers by highlighting the unique architectural design, the integration with the natural landscape, and the distinct floating exhibition spaces, ultimately encouraging them to visit and 'save' the location for their trip.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines minimalist architectural beauty with a tranquil seaside atmosphere, effectively using soft acoustic music to create a 'healing' travel experience.
